compute_energy: compute system-level energy from node embeddings and an energy block module with sum or mean reduction
compute_forces: compute atomic forces as the negative gradient of energy with respect to atomic positions
compute_forces_and_stress: compute forces and stress tensor from energy using autograd gradients with respect to positions and cell vectors
compute_hessian: compute the Hessian matrix as the second derivative of energy with respect to atomic positions using vmap or loop
reduce_node_to_system: reduce node-level tensor values to system-level by summing over nodes in each system with graph parallel support
